title: Agent pane torn-stream corruption fix
intent: Writing RED tests for post-drop pane output suppression in ClientQueue
progress_summary: Issue #4206 root cause identified: the #4095 fix IS present in v9.94.1 (verified by git merge-base against the tag), so this is not a revert. The remaining hole is in ClientQueue::enqueue (crates/gwt/src/embedded_server.rs): once a terminal_output chunk is dropped at LOSSY_HIGH_WATER, every SUBSEQUENT chunk of the same pane is still delivered. The client applies that suffix to a screen missing the dropped prefix, so cursor-positioning escapes land at wrong offsets - exactly the character-offset interleaving reported.
